# Color list throws, chip label overlaps its chips, form app Save throws

## Context

I found these while opening every Forms & Fields entry for the Engine 14 slate ([#21142, comment 6980411401](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980411401)) on `dev` `0128668721`. The target in #21140 publishes the field types as tiles cropped at rest and renews the form app as a card, and a visitor meets all three defects there.

## The Problem

1. **The color field's list never opens.** Clicking the trigger of `examples/form/field/color` throws, and nothing opens:
   ```
   TypeError: me.colorFormatter is not a function
       at Color.createItemContent (src/list/Color.mjs:60:27)
       at Color.createItem (src/list/Base.mjs:523:35)
       at Color.createItems (src/list/Base.mjs:666:22)
       at Color.onStoreLoad (src/list/Base.mjs:977:16)
       at Color.afterSetStore (src/list/Base.mjs:418:37)
   ```
2. **The chip field's inline label sits over its chips.** `examples/form/field/chip` opens with "US States" drawn across "California" and "New York". The label moves above them only after focus.
3. **The form app's Save throws.** Pressing Save in `apps/form` raises `me is not defined`, and nothing is stored.

## The Architectural Reality

1. `ComboBox#beforeSetListConfig()` (`src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:387`) calls `parseItemConfigs(value)` to resolve the `'@config:'` strings in `listConfig`. Commit `6c8b81c848` (12 Jan 2026, `#8571`/`#8572`) changed `core.Base#parseItemConfigs()` (`src/core/Base.mjs:857`): it now reads a plain object as a keyed items map and recurses into each value, so the object's own entries are never resolved. `form.field.Color` sets `colorField: '@config:colorField'` and `colorFormatter: '@config:colorFormatter'` in its `listConfig` (`src/form/field/Color.mjs:41-42`), and `list.Color` receives the literal strings. `wrapper.AmChart#beforeSetChartConfig()` (`src/component/wrapper/AmChart.mjs:137`) passes one config object the same way. The COVID apps' world maps set `maxValue: '@config:heatRulesMaxValue'` in their heat rules (`apps/covid/view/WorldMapComponent.mjs:57`, `apps/sharedcovid/view/WorldMapComponent.mjs:57`), which the old path reached through the `series` array.
2. `form.field.Text` toggles `neo-has-content` only in `afterSetInputValue()` (`src/form/field/Text.mjs:561`) and `afterSetPlaceholderText()`. A chip field holds its value in chips and keeps its input empty, so a value never reaches that toggle. Design authority: `Chip#hasContent()` counts the value, `return this.value?.length > 0 || super.hasContent()` (`src/form/field/Chip.mjs:433`), and Text's own rule reads "labelPosition: 'inline' should keep the label at the top" for a field with content (`src/form/field/Text.mjs:784-785`).
3. `FormContainerController#onSaveButtonClick()` reads `me` without declaring it (`apps/form/view/FormContainerController.mjs:47`).

## The Fix

1. `ComboBox#beforeSetListConfig()` and `AmChart#beforeSetChartConfig()` pass their config as one item, `this.parseItemConfigs([value])`, which is the path every single object took before `6c8b81c848`. The keyed-map branch stays for `container.Base` items (`src/container/Base.mjs:880`).
2. `Chip#afterSetValue()` toggles `neo-has-content` from `hasContent()` once its value list is synced.
3. `onSaveButtonClick()` declares `me`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In `examples/form/field/color`, the trigger opens the color list with a coloured square per item and no console error. A unit spec pins that the list's `colorFormatter` and `colorField` are the field's own; it is red on `dev` and green with the fix.
- [ ] AC-2: A unit spec pins that a keyed items map still resolves per item, the branch `#8571` added.
- [ ] AC-3: `examples/form/field/chip` opens with its label above the chips. A unit spec pins `neo-has-content` on a chip field whose value is set while its input is empty; it is red on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-4: In `apps/form`, Save stores the form's values under the localStorage key `neo-form` with no error.
- [ ] AC-5: The COVID world map's heat rule receives a number for `maxValue`, not the `'@config:'` string.
- [ ] AC-6: The pull request shows 1440 × 900 frames of the color list open, the chip field at rest and the form app after Save, before and after the fix.

## Out of Scope

- The email field's error layout. In a left-labelled field without a character count, the error message shares the input's row and shrinks the input to its 50 px `min-width`. Where every text field shows its error is a layout decision of its own, captured as a defect-note.
- The field tiles and the states of #21140's Tiles and Forms & Fields lanes.

## Avoided Traps

- **Teaching `parseItemConfigs()` to guess** whether an object is a keyed items map or one config. The callers know which one they pass.
- **Toggling `neo-has-content` in `Text#afterSetValue()` for every field.** Text and ComboBox already keep value and input in step; only the chip field holds its value outside the input.
